project: LWYL friction component finalize, four-type model plus experience
instructions: Read this file first, every session, before any work.
Work tasks in order of dependency. A task is workable only when every id in depends_on is done.
A task is done only when its completion_criteria AND testing_criteria are met and a separate check confirms it. Never mark done from your own say-so.
After each task, set status and write result with the evidence, the file changed, the test output, the reviewer verdict, the deploy state.
Single writer. In a parallel run, only the orchestrating session edits this file. Parallel agents report back, the orchestrator records status.
If a task is skipped or descoped, set status blocked or descoped and say why in result. Never silently drop a task.
hard_rules: All work on the branch above, never on main until the confirm phase passes and Daniel signs off.
Mockup before code. No screen changes until its mockup is built and Daniel approves it.
The old model stays until the new one is confirmed. Never remove calculateFriction or the old vocabulary before task confirm-new-model is done.
Validator then blindspot-reviewer on every methodology change, before approval.
Deploy incrementally, one screen per commit, confirm Vercel READY before the next.
Writing, no em dashes, no semicolons, no ellipses, active voice, strength leads.
